local.h: How to serve a safe Thanksgiving meal
local.b: Food poisoning outbreaks tend to rise in November and December, the CDC says, with tainted turkey, undercooked stuffing and holiday buffets behind past illnesses. Here's how to avoid them.
local.title: What to do to have a safe Thanksgiving meal

local.h: Delta system glitch delays flights at Atlanta airport
local.b: An issue with Delta's weight and balance system at Hartsfield-Jackson is delaying thousands of flights ahead of Thanksgiving, the FAA said.
local.title: Delta delays flights ahead of Thanksgiving holiday over system failure

local.h: Abandoned dog family found in the cold in Orange, NJ
local.b: Animal protection officers found two dogs tied to a fence in Orange, just west of Newark, along with five newborn puppies. One puppy died, the Associated Humane Societies said.
local.title: 1 puppy dead, another fighting for its life after dog family abandoned in NJ cold

local.h: Aber Kawas becomes first Palestinian in New York state Senate
local.b: Aber Kawas won election as the first Palestinian in New York Senate history, celebrating with hundreds of Democratic Socialists of America members on election night.

local.h: Jersey City rent control push ends in setback for DSA members
local.b: A bill from progressive Jersey City council members to protect tenants of a waterfront high-rise from rent hikes was tossed before it could be formally introduced.

goodnews.h: Adopt a storm drain? Council bill would enlist New Yorkers
goodnews.b: A City Council bill would let residents volunteer to clear leaves and litter from storm drains on their block, building on a pilot in Greenpoint, Brooklyn, to help prevent flooding.
goodnews.title: Adopt a storm drain? NYC proposal aims to enlist residents in flood prevention.

local.h: Activists demand tear gas suspension over reported health effects
local.b: French activists and lawmakers want police to stop using tear gas after women reported menstrual changes following protests. An advocacy group says it has over 10,000 complaints; scientists have not confirmed a link.

local.h: Le Pen denies receiving secrets from civil servant
local.b: Marine Le Pen denied receiving confidential information from a civil servant suspected of leaking investigation details to her National Rally party, but said she could not say whether others in the party had.
local.title: France's Le Pen denies receiving secrets from civil servant

local.h: Budget talks and Black Friday top France's week ahead
local.b: Lawmakers meet in committee to try to strike a deal on the social security budget, a trial opens for seven men accused of raising funds for the PKK, and retailers gear up for Black Friday.
local.title: Budget wrangling and Black Friday: What’s on the agenda in France this week

local.h: France sees sixth straight weekend of cost-of-living protests
local.b: Tens of thousands marched in French cities on Saturday demanding better public services and protesting rising prices and inequality, though turnout has dwindled.
local.title: French protesters rally for sixth weekend over living costs and public services

local.h: Seattle lab aims to break down 'forever chemicals'
local.b: Nature has no tools to break down PFAS, the so-called forever chemicals invented in the 1930s. A Seattle protein design lab is trying to build some.
local.title: Seattle lab looks to break the bonds that make 'forever chemicals' last

local.h: Father and daughter held by ICE at Sea-Tac were headed to a baptism
local.b: The father and daughter detained by masked immigration officers on a Sea-Tac jet bridge Saturday were traveling to a family baptism in California, their lawyer said. Passenger videos of the arrest were widely viewed.
local.title: Lawyer: Father and daughter detained by ICE at Seattle airport were traveling to family baptism

local.h: Medicare open enrollment runs through Dec. 7
local.b: Open enrollment is underway for Medicare, which covers roughly 70 million people, and coverage choices for 2027 are complex and often consequential. The season ends Dec. 7.
local.title: Medicare looks a bit different in 2027, so don't miss open enrollment
